text:
maria: Heads up 9 I ran into a support case where a tenant onboarding flow failed due to label validation. Our examples still show `team_alpha` in a few quickstart places which is causing confusion.
ben: saw that too. Support ticket showed `400 invalid_tenant_label`. We should standardize examples to kebab-case (team-alpha) and add a short note about allowed characters.
josh: agree. backend accepts lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only. length 3-64. we should include the regex in docs so customers can validate before calling the API.
emily: there's an SDK quirk: our python helper silently converts underscores to hyphens in one path which hides the real problem and leads to mismatched records. filed RED-7654 internally. until it's fixed, docs need a warning.
maria: copied redacted log from support for context:

```
POST /v1/dedicated/tenants 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "invalid_tenant_label",
  "detail": "label contains invalid character '_'"
}
```

ben: For the docs change I propose:
- Replace all example labels with kebab-case (team-alpha)
- Add a "Label validation" subsection in the quickstart with JS and Python validator snippets
- Troubleshooting entry for `400 invalid_tenant_label` describing causes and remediation
- Note calling out the SDK behavior that strips underscores until the patch lands

josh: snippet idea for JS to paste in the quickstart:
```
function validateTenantLabel(label) {
  const re = /^[a-z0-9-]{3,64}$/;
  if (!re.test(label)) {
    throw new Error('Tenant label invalid: use 3-64 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens');
  }
}
```

emily: Python equivalent for the CLI YAML case so users can pre-validate before apply:
```
import re

def validate_label(label):
    if not re.match(r'^[a-z0-9-]{3,64}$', label):
        raise ValueError('Tenant label invalid: use 3-64 chars, lowercase letters, or hyphens')
```

maria: also add a one-liner about telemetry: labels are normalized to lowercase in logs, so uppercase input will be lowercased downstream. worth a note in the quickstart.
ben: i'll put together a small PR with the examples and troubleshooting bits. adding the validator snippets and a regex block. PR draft: https://git.internal/rw/docs/pulls/5870 (WIP)
josh: please include a regression test suggestion in the PR: e.g. ensure `create_tenant('team_alpha')` returns a proper error / doesn't silently mutate.
emily: SDK fix timeline: created internal issue RED-7654 and assigned to SDK team. i'll paste the SDK PR link here when it's up. until then, docs callout will reference the internal issue id.
sev_ops_bot: deploy-checklist: docs PR must include links to the SDK issue, mention which SDK versions are affected, and add an item to remove the temporary warning once SDK patch merges.
maria: OK action items:
- Ben: finish docs PR (examples + validators + troubleshooting entry) 0 PR 5870, target EOD Wed
- Emily: track SDK issue RED-7654 and post SDK PR link here when ready
- Josh: add telemetry normalization sentence to quickstart during PR review
- Maria: follow-up to remove warning post-SDK-PR and add an internal playground link for label testing

ai-docs-bot: Suggested copy for troubleshooting (pasteable): "Tenant labels must only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (3-64 chars). If the API returns `400 invalid_tenant_label`, convert the label to kebab-case. Note: older SDKs may strip underscores; see internal issue RED-7654 for details."

ben: thanks 0 i'll update the PR and ping everyone when draft is ready. :thumbsup:
